svg.title: Where two answers live: the 45 facts read backwards
svg.desc: Upper triangle of the 9 by 9 times table. Eighteen cells whose product has a second factor pair carry a gold inlay; five cells whose product needs two copies of one digit are drawn as stacked pairs; digits 5 and 7 are marked as irreplaceable.

text.font-family: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 45 facts, read backwards. Each cell shows the product a Factor board would print.

text.font-family: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
